description:
BLOCKER for fz-go4.18.4 (found while about to land the deletion): the deletion attempt DELETED ~13 compiler2_runtime_demand_* behavioral-contract tests instead of PORTING them — only 1 product-path survivor (compiler2_pull_runtime_demand_keeps_enum_reduce_operator_refs_direct_callable). These are load-bearing callable-boundary semantics, not legacy mechanism. Same lost-coverage shortcut .18.8 correctly avoided for transport; the seal's runtime_demand.defined telemetry was their OBSERVATION point, deleted with the spine — the SEMANTICS live on the product path (session.memo().runtime_demand / the RuntimeDemand product).

DELETED (recover bodies from 862262ee:src/compiler2/semantic_analysis_test.rs; confirmed real contracts, e.g. compiler2_runtime_demand_marks_an_escaped_callable_first_class asserts escape&&!opaque, 1 first_class_surface, 1 resolution): marks_an_escaped_callable_first_class, marks_callable_arguments_to_opaque_calls_first_class, marks_joined_function_refs_first_class_before_reduce_boundary, makes_opaque_callable_use_explicit, keeps_a_returned_direct_callable_out_of_first_class_inventory, leaves_an_unused_callable_input_omitted, keeps_dbg_inputs_live_when_the_return_is_ignored, delivers_boundary_return_demand_to_escaped_callable_target, preserves_reducer_surface_when_suspend_continuation_escapes, preserves_tuple_return_shape_for_escaped_callable_boundaries, records_recursive_tuple_resume_value_demand, records_the_exact_surface_for_a_direct_lambda_call, resolves_enum_take_first_class_reducer_surfaces_before_transport. (Also 2 runtime_demand telemetry-contract tests — those are legacy-signal-name tests; port to the product telemetry OR drop-with-justification.)

FIX (like .18.8): re-point each to observe the PRODUCT runtime demand — build a Compiler2, drive the product (product_activation_inventory / backend product), read session.memo().runtime_demand(exec) and assert the SAME callable_flows contracts (escape/opaque/direct_surfaces/first_class_surfaces/resolutions). Do this on CLEAN HEAD (862262ee, world.runtime_demand STILL PRESENT) so each port can be CROSS-CHECKED against the store-based assertion for the same fixture. No shim, no weakened assertions. Then the spine deletion removes the store with ZERO lost coverage. Blocks fz-go4.18.4.
title: Port the ~13 runtime-demand contract tests to product-path observation before deleting the spine
